If you are flying drones in South America, then you need to know the drone rules.

On this page we list the drone laws in South American Countries: Each South American Country is listed showing a summary of drone regulation by country – Follow links to the desired Country Drone Regulations where you will find Official links and Drone Laws explained for residents and visitors, hobbyists, recreational, commercial and government drone flyers.
NOTE: Countries are grouped into Continents using Wikipedia List of countries by continents.
Some countries may be listed on multiple continents.
